post.description:
You have a Delaware file number (from `search` or a filing) and need the registration record and registered agent.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

file_number.description: Delaware file number, digits only (e.g. 6872331). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,10}$.

200.description:
Free Delaware entity details for one file number (the ICIS 'Entity Details' page reached through the search postback): entity name, incorporation/formation date (M/D/YYYY as the site prints it), entity kind and type, residency, state, and the registered agent's name, address, city, county, state, postal code and phone. The site's paid status, franchise tax and filing history are not fetched. Fails with not_found when the registry reports 'No Records Found.' for the file number.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `file_number` | string |  |
| `incorporation_date` | string | Incorporation / formation date as printed by the site (M/D/YYYY); null when the site leaves the field empty. |
| `incorporation_date_format` | string |  |
| `kind` | string | Entity kind (e.g. Corporation, Limited Liability Company). |
| `name` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `registered_agent` | object |  |
| `residency` | string | Domestic or Foreign. |
| `source` | string |  |
| `state` | string | Jurisdiction of formation as printed (e.g. DELAWARE). |
| `status_included` | boolean | Always false: legal status, tax and history are paid lookups on the site and are never fetched. |
| `type` | string | Entity type (e.g. General, Public Benefit Corporation). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

post.description:
You know an entity name or a Delaware file number and need the matching registrations and their file numbers; follow up with `entity` for the free details.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

file_number.description: Delaware file number (digits only, e.g. 6872331). Exactly one of `name` or `file_number`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,10}$.

name.description: Entity name or name fragment. Wrap the whole name in double quotes for the site's exact-name search. Exactly one of `name` or `file_number`.

200.description:
Search the Delaware ICIS entity registry by entity name (substring, case-insensitive; wrap the name in double quotes for the site's exact-name search) or by file number. Returns up to 50 rows of file number and entity name; the site caps a query at 50 rows without pagination, reported as `truncated: true` with the site's notice. No legal status is included (the site sells that separately).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number | Rows returned (0 when the site reports 'No Records Found.'). |
| `entities` | object[] |  |
| `notice` | string | The site's result message verbatim ('No Records Found.', the 50-row cap notice), null when the site shows none. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `query` | object |  |
| `source` | string |  |
| `status_included` | boolean | Always false: current legal status is a paid lookup on the site and is never fetched. |
| `truncated` | boolean | true when the site reports that the query exceeded its 50-row cap; refine the name to see the rest. The site has no pagination. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
